purpose: Independent numerical physics validation; no performance claims.

numerical_conventions.scattering: Neutral real IT92 elastic factors, positions angstrom, q inverse angstrom.
numerical_conventions.sampled_mean_error: Complex amplitude error divided by sqrt(exact physical variance/sample count).
numerical_conventions.conditioning: Template selected first; position conditioned separately at fixed template, preserving number weights.
numerical_conventions.limits: Synthetic geometric fixtures validate the model equations, not a force field, physical MOF loading, or experimental accuracy.

cases.fixture: Two inversion-expanded triclinic cells at indices (0,1,0) and (1,0,0); two independent pores per cell; vacancy/monomer/trimer states; 81 complete configurations.
cases.equation: E[I(q)] = sum_s P(s) |sum_i f_i(q) exp(i q.r_i,s)|^2 = |S(q)|^2 |H(q)+mu(q)|^2 + M Var(A_guest(q))
